tasks.title: Daily List tennis: 39/51 against 42 expected
tasks.brief:
Over the last 28 days the tennis Daily List picks: 39 of 51 landed (76%) against 42.2 expected (83% quoted), z -1.2. The List promises at least 80% and quotes that match what lands. Find where the shortfall sits (league or tournament, 5-point band, home or away pick, Celtic's Law, early season) and whether the bar or the quote is wrong. Suspects from the site README: the cumulative tested rate shown on rows (own-band rates are stricter), and tier-2 leagues at a 75% bar. If a stricter admission rule would have landed 80% on history, ship it.

Use the live record only to locate the gap: never fit on record.json (Rule 1). Test any fix on history, paired and bootstrapped, fitted on the last completed season and confirmed on the current one (Rule 3 gates: 250+ check games, p(worse) at most 0.30, gain at least 0.0005 log loss). If it passes, ship the code change with its evidence. If it does not, ship a dated claude/ note with the numbers so nobody repeats it. Check claude/ and RELEASES.md first: if this exact idea was already rejected, test a different one.
